meta.homeTitle: WallHaze — AI Wallpapers for Every Screen
meta.homeDescription: Create stunning AI wallpapers made for your device. Explore unique styles — anime, cyberpunk, fantasy and more — in high quality for phone, tablet and desktop.
meta.studioDescription: The WallHaze studio: describe your wallpaper, pick a style, choose your device and aspect ratio, add a reference image and generate high-quality AI wallpapers for phone, tablet and desktop.
meta.wallpapersDescription: Browse free wallpapers for phone, tablet and desktop. Artwork with cleared licensing is downloadable; items still under review are view-only. Every wallpaper has its own detail page.
meta.loginDescription: Sign in to WallHaze to manage your account, Credits and creations. Account services are being prepared and sign-in is not open yet.
meta.signupDescription: Create a WallHaze account to keep your Credits and creations. Account services are being prepared and registration is not open yet.
meta.accountDescription: Your WallHaze account center: profile, settings, Credits and orders. Account services are being prepared.
meta.creditsDescription: WallHaze Credits power AI wallpaper generation. See your real balance, packages and orders in the Credits center.
meta.myCreationsDescription: Your locally saved AI wallpaper generations — stored on this device only, with download and reuse.
meta.aboutDescription: What WallHaze is today: a free AI wallpaper gallery and a Studio for creating your own wallpapers, in seven languages.
meta.faqDescription: Answers about the free gallery, which artwork can be downloaded, the AI Studio, Credits, licensing and local history.
meta.helpDescription: How to use WallHaze: browse the gallery, download cleared artwork, use the Studio, and troubleshoot common issues.
meta.contactDescription: How to reach the WallHaze team. Official contact channels will be published here once they are available.
meta.privacyDescription: WallHaze privacy policy working draft — pending legal review and not yet in effect.
meta.termsDescription: WallHaze terms of service working draft — pending legal review and not yet in effect.
meta.communityDescription: Discover static and live wallpapers from independent creators, submitted by email and published after human review.

studio.subtitle: Everything you need to design, generate and collect wallpapers — prompt it, pick a style, dial in the ratio, and save what you love.

popular.title: Browse by style
popular.subtitle: Six signature looks to start from — open any style in the Studio and make it yours.

studioIntro.title: Design it. Generate it. Set it.
studioIntro.body: The Studio is WallHaze’s creative workspace: describe what you want to see, pick a signature style, dial in the exact ratio and resolution for your device — and keep the result in your personal library.
studioIntro.feature1Body: Start from hand-tuned presets — from neon cyberpunk to cozy anime — or write a prompt that’s entirely your own.
studioIntro.feature2Body: Phone, tablet or desktop: choose a device preset, an aspect ratio and a resolution — including one recommended for your current screen.
studioIntro.feature3Body: Attach a subject photo to guide the composition and scene; the Studio previews the result before you save it.
studioIntro.visualAlt: Wallpaper sample preview in a phone frame

why.title: Built differently, on purpose
why.item1Body: From a 9:16 phone lock screen to a 16:9 desktop, wallpapers are composed for the device you actually use.
why.item2Body: Browse a hand-picked gallery with clear labels; cleared artwork can be downloaded without an account.
why.item3Body: Clear labels for what’s live, what’s in review and what needs an account — you always know what you’re looking at.
why.item4Body: The whole experience speaks your language — English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español, Français and Deutsch.

about.title: About WallHaze
about.intro: WallHaze is an AI wallpaper product for phone, tablet and desktop — a free gallery of ready-made wallpapers plus a Studio for creating your own.
about.whatBody: The gallery offers free, hand-picked AI wallpapers in many styles — anime, cyberpunk, fantasy, nature and more — each with a detail page and, when licensing is cleared, direct download. The Studio lets you create your own wallpaper from a description, style, device and optional reference image.
about.capGalleryBody: Browse and search wallpapers for every screen; cleared artwork can be downloaded without an account.
about.capStudioBody: A complete creation flow — the final generation submit opens together with account and Credits services.
about.capLanguagesBody: The whole site is localized into English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French and German.
about.roadmapBody: Account sign-in, the Credits wallet, paid AI generation and cloud-saved creations are planned but not connected yet. Features appear on the site only when their backend services are real.
about.disclaimerBody: This page describes only confirmed capabilities. Company details, team size, user counts and partners are not stated because none have been confirmed.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Short answers about the gallery, the Studio, Credits and licensing.
faq.q1Q: How do I use the free gallery?
faq.q1A: Open the Gallery, browse by category or style, or search by name and mood. Every wallpaper has its own detail page — no account is needed.
faq.q2Q: How do I download a wallpaper?
faq.q2A: Use the Download button when it is shown on a card or detail page. Artwork still under licensing review is view-only; cleared artwork saves directly or opens in a new tab if the browser blocks the download.
faq.q3A: The Studio is where you describe a wallpaper in your own words, pick a style, device and aspect ratio, and optionally add a reference image. Submitting requires an account and Credits; when the site is not connected to its services, the Studio says exactly what is missing instead of pretending to generate.
faq.q4A: Credits are WallHaze's prepaid balance for AI generation. Prices and balances only ever come from the WallHaze backend — nothing is simulated or estimated in the browser.
faq.q5Q: Why is generation not open yet?
faq.q5A: Real generation costs money per request, so it is gated behind sign-in, a server-side price and a Credits balance. If any of those cannot be verified, the submit path stays blocked rather than pretending to generate.
faq.q6Q: Can I use the wallpapers commercially?
faq.q6A: The gallery is free to browse. Download is available only for artwork whose licensing review is complete; a public download does not grant a commercial license. Each detail page shows the current status.
faq.q7Q: What is the difference between local history and cloud creations?
faq.q7A: Your generation history is stored only in this browser (up to 20 entries) — it is not backed up, not synced, and clearing browser data removes it. Cloud-stored creations across devices are planned but not available yet.
faq.q8A: Not for the gallery. An account is required for the AI Studio and the Credits wallet; sign-in and registration open with the paid services.

help.title: Help & troubleshooting
help.subtitle: How to use WallHaze and what to do when something misbehaves.
help.startBody: Start in the Gallery: filter by category or style, search by name or mood, and open any wallpaper for details, licensing status and download availability.
help.downloadBody: Press Download when it is available on a card or detail page and the file saves to your device. Artwork under licensing review does not show a download control.
help.studioBody: Describe your wallpaper, pick a style, then choose device, aspect ratio and size. You can attach a reference image (PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB). The final submit step is currently disabled — see the FAQ for why.
help.t1Body: Check your connection and try again. Some browsers block programmatic downloads — the image then opens in a new tab. If the download control is absent, the artwork is still under licensing review.
help.t2Body: Generation history lives in your browser's local storage (max 20 entries). Private browsing, storage cleanup or a cleared cache removes it — this cannot be recovered.
help.t3Title: An image looks broken or expired
help.t3Body: Some generated images are stored at temporary URLs that can expire. The record keeps your prompt and settings, so you can recreate it in the Studio.
help.moreHelpLabel: More questions? Check the FAQ or the Contact page.
